name: Aksan
source:
"I have lived a very long life. I have seen many start and complete their journey. You will just be another face, ultimately forgotten in the stream of Time."

The Wandering Queen, Aksan, comes and goes from Yonder World for several purposes, one of which is to deliver new literary works to Dethiral. Glamorous, dangerous and resourceful, she carries many secrets in her confident strides.

Aksan is a mystery that draws people's eyes, and a knife in the dark where none is looking.

[From [url=https://flutteringabyss.itch.io/yonderworld]Itch.io[/url]]
